evidence.source: Kosarac et al. (2021), Frontiers in Chemistry 9:756745, unheated MCT oil, Table 1; ABITEC CAPTEX product identity
evidence.material: unheated commercial St. Francis Herb Farm C8/C10 MCT oil from a health-food store; formulation-dependent
evidence.verification: The original oil was separately analyzed before emissions were generated. Table 1 identifies trioctanoin (tricaprylin) (CAS 538-23-8) as an individual molecular species by non-targeted GC-MS, alongside mixed C8/C10 triglycerides. Manufacturer separately names corresponding CAPTEX tricaprylin/tricaprin identities. No individual concentration was calibrated; no fatty-acid-fraction-to-molecule conversion or emission result transferred to food.
evidence.description: Identified in a studied commercial C8/C10 MCT oil; content depends on the formulation and a separate amount is unavailable.
